items.text:
surface
coords
text
font
fill
anchor

set token [ lindex $tokens $i ]
set color [ lindex $colors $i ]

incr lcount
lappend widths $line_width
set line_width 0

set line_width [ lindex $widths 0 ]
set cx [ expr { int($x - $line_width / 2) } ]
set line_id 0

incr cy $line_height
incr line_id
set line_width [ lindex $widths $line_id ]
set cx [ expr { int($x - $line_width / 2) } ]
